business_problem: Podium needed to help local businesses capture after-hours demand, follow brand-specific sales rules, and convert leads without forcing SMB owners to configure complex software or hire more staff.
solution_summary: Podium evolved early spam-filtering and lead-enrichment experiments into Jerry, an AI agent that acts more like a teammate than a script. Jerry uses GPT-5.1 to handle lead capture, appointment scheduling, service requests, sales conversations, and follow-up across messaging channels, while preferences let each business tune tone, terminology, and policies without engineering help. Podium combines vertical baselines for industries such as automotive, home services, aesthetics, and retail with business-level customization, so each deployment starts with a strong template and adapts to the operator's workflows. An evaluation framework replays production-like scenarios and measures conversion rather than just correctness; in head-to-head tests GPT-5.1 delivered better win rates, lower cost per conversation, and faster responses. Internal teams also use ChatGPT Enterprise and OpenAI APIs to build onboarding flows and playbooks, extending the same agentic operating model beyond the product.
